key_insight: AMIFound brings medical image restoration and enhancement across seven imaging modalities into one foundation model. It handles diverse image degradations while preserving clinically relevant information for diagnosis.
problem_solved: Medical imaging spans multiple modalities and degradation types, making restoration difficult to address with a single approach. This work tackles that fragmentation while aiming to retain diagnostically important image details.
method: Use a unified foundation model, AMIFound, for medical image restoration and enhancement.
Support seven imaging modalities within the same model.
Address diverse degradations while preserving clinically relevant information.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, AMIFound demonstrates the potential of a shared foundation model to replace fragmented restoration approaches across medical imaging tasks. Its focus on diagnostic information highlights why enhancement quality must go beyond visual appeal.

paper_title: An all-in-one foundation model for multimodal medical image restoration and enhancement
paper_authors: Luyang Cao, Zhijian Wu, Jian Zhang, Lei Qi, Yang Gao
